doc.title: Jack DeJohnette interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 7, 2025

title: Coltrane as a sponge
summary: He describes how Coltrane absorbed the sound around him and brought out the best in players.

story.theme_name: Playing with Coltrane and the avant-garde

blocks.x: You had a — I’ll just wrap up here with a quote you had from this interview I watched yesterday. And you said, “Coltrane would suck up whatever you gave him” and then you actually physically described it. And I thought it was a wonderful image and you had to keep giving it to him. I can see how you’d be exhausted by that.

Yeah, I mean he’s like a sponge you know. He absorbed the sound that was around him. So you know it brought out the best in your playing. So yeah, so like I say and others too, he put the “Om” back in jazz.
